criteria.criterion: A new unit test in crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs builds a root-cause request with root_cause_request from a fixture introspection/cause and asserts the text asks first (earlier position in the text) for the missing information to be supplied to the failing stage (brief, system facts or reader's inputs). Check: cargo test -p athena-core hestia passes and the test is listed.
criteria.evidence: New test a_root_cause_request_asks_for_missing_information_before_any_refusal_rule builds two fixture introspections, takes repeated_causes, calls root_cause_request, asserts the text contains 'give that information to it', 'in its brief', 'system facts' and "reader's inputs", and asserts info < rule position. The run listed it as ok (71 passed, 0 failed).

criteria.criterion: The same test asserts the text mentions adding a refusal rule only as allowed when giving the information cannot prevent the failure, and requires the request to state the expected share of past accepted readings it would refuse; the asserted refusal-rule mention comes after the information ask. Check: cargo test -p athena-core hestia.
criteria.evidence: The test finds 'Add a new refusal rule only when giving the information cannot prevent the failure' and 'Expected share of past accepted readings it would refuse: N%'. It asserts info < rule < share and that 'refusal rule' appears exactly once. The test passed.

findings.summary: The new test fails cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings (field_reassign_with_default).
findings.evidence: cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings exits 101: 'field assignment outside of initializer for an instance created with Default::default()' at hestia.rs:3830. CI run 42752210363 recorded the same clippy failure. Fix: `let records = Records { introspections: vec![...], ..Default::default() };`.

summary: The candidate fails. Clippy with -D warnings rejects the new test, and the request requires clippy to pass. The rest of the change does what was asked. The root-cause template in root_cause_request_at now asks first for the information the failing stage lacked (its brief, the system facts or the reader's inputs). It allows a new refusal rule only when that information cannot prevent the failure, and then requires the line 'Expected share of past accepted readings it would refuse: N%'. The acceptance list is unchanged. The new test checks the order of these parts and passes. The existing hestia tests still pass, the CHANGELOG entry is present, and only the two expected files changed. The clippy error is field_reassign_with_default at hestia.rs:3830, where the test assigns records.introspections after Records::default(). Building the struct with `..Default::default()` would fix it. CI run 42752210363 recorded this failure and my rerun reproduced it.
